metadata.name: GetPaymentScheduleTransaction
metadata.description: This API is used to get transactions of each scheduled payments.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ScheduleID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for Schedule Payment. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:25874 Condition: Either ScheduleID or Page, Limit is required.

request_fields.name: Action
request_fields.description: If Action is blank or Null then all transaction will be returned. 1 = All 2 = Successful 3 = Fail 4= Skipped Valid Values: 1,2,3, Example:1

request_fields.name: Page
request_fields.description: Use to display  transactions  for a particular page. It's always be greater than or equal To 1 Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX Example:1 Condition : This is mandatory if 'ScheduleID is' not supplied.

request_fields.name: Limit
request_fields.description: Display number of transactions  in a page. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX Example:50 Condition : This is mandatory if 'ScheduleID is' not supplied.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TransactionList
children.description: TransactionList

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted.

children.name: PostedDate
children.description: Date when transaction was posted. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction.

children.name: Description
children.description: Detailed description of Transaction. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting reference (Like -Transaction Posted Successfully) Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentStatus
children.description: Paid Or Payment Reversed Initially this can be Paid for any transaction but if we receive its Reversal then it will become Payment Reversed Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ReturnReasonCode
children.description: Return Reason Code For ACH payment Reversal Transactions. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ReversalTranid
children.description: Transaction id of Transaction which reversed this payment.

children.name: ReversalDate
children.description: Date Time when reversed transaction was initiated. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: ScheduleID
children.description: Unique identifier for Schedule Payment.

children.name: BankName
children.description: Name of bank against payment method is being used for payment. Allowable Values: 255

children.name: BankAccountType
children.description: Type of Bank account added by customer for card payment Possible values 0 = Checking, 1 = Savings Allowable Values: 15

children.name: BAMLast4Digit
children.description: Last 4 digit of bank account number. Allowable Values: 4

children.name: Frequency
children.description: Payment frequency Possible values 0—Monthly Specific Day 1—Payment Due Date 2—One Time 3—Weekly 4—Instant Pay 5—Daily 6—Bi-Weekly 7—Semi-Monthly

children.name: ExternalErrorMessage
children.description: Error message, if any. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentReferenceId
children.description: Reference ID of the Payment. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PaymentMode
children.description: Mode of payment being made Possible Values 0—ACH 1—Debit Card With Token 2—Debit Card With Card Number 3—APC Payment 4—Lock Box 5—Bill Pay Payment 6—Manual Payment Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RequestID
children.description: Unique identifier for request made.

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking. Example:7485122 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: TotalNumberOfTxns
children.description: Total number of transactions in the response.

sample_response.Message: Payment schedule transaction(s) information returned successfully.
